title: Heartbreaker Knight
description: A small armored knight with purple horns and glowing red eyes stands in a dark stone chamber, clutching a bouquet of red hearts while surrounded by broken hearts and purple ghostly figures. Ribbons, smoke, and floating hearts fill the scene as beams of light cut through the gloom from above.
prompt: A small armored knight with large curved purple horns and glowing red eyes stands in a dark stone dungeon covered in vines, wearing a metal helmet with a faceplate, holding a bouquet of red hearts in both hands, surrounded by floating broken hearts, purple translucent ghostly figures with glowing eyes, purple ribbons and smoke swirling around, dramatic beams of light from above, dark fantasy atmosphere, detailed digital painting
